bibliographic.title: enabler
bibliographic.author: Crow
bibliographic.description:
enabler

is a cautionary tale.

Nearly a fable. Inspired by stories heard again and again.

Enabler is the story of trying to see the best in something that can't change, someone who won't change.

Enabler contains scenes of abuse.

Enabler is a story of abuse.

Please be careful when reading if you are sensitive to such topics.

There are seven endings. I don't think you could consider any of them good.
